$schema_note: Standardized color palette for Lucid process maps. Reference these tokens by name in your node and lane definitions. If you need to change the palette later, change it once here.

terminator_start_end.purpose: Workflow start, end, IN handoff, OUT handoff. Yellow oval.

terminator_success_end.purpose: Successful workflow completion. Green oval. Use to distinguish positive end-states from generic IN/OUT terminators.

process.purpose: Standard process step or matching action. Blue rectangle.

system_action.purpose: System or API call, webhook, event fire, AI action. Indigo rectangle.

decision.purpose: Branching decision. Yellow diamond. Must be 280w × 140h minimum.

database_write.purpose: Database or CRM record create / update / delete. Magenta rectangle.

out_of_scope.purpose: Excluded population or out-of-scope branch shown for context. Red rectangle.

warning_callout.purpose: Bug, gap, or risk callout. Red rectangle. Text begins with WARNING: or BUG: followed by one-sentence description.

sub_process_link.purpose: Link to a separate sub-process map. Purple rectangle. Width 3 stroke emphasizes the cross-document nature.

lane_headers_functional.$comment: Functional lanes describe stages of work, not systems. Use for routing-heavy or process-flow maps.

lane_headers_neutral_system.$comment: Neutral lane color tokens for system lanes. Use these as starting points and remap to specific systems in your project palette (e.g., colors-justworks.json).

lane_header_rule: ALWAYS use light fills with dark default text. Saturated dark fills with white text fail readability. The lane fill should be a paler shade of the same hue family.

cross_system_handoff.purpose: Emphasize a handoff between systems or workflows. Use sparingly.

bug_risk_link.purpose: Link a warning_callout to the node it describes. No arrowhead.

auto_convert_implicit.purpose: Implicit chain or auto-convert relationship (e.g., Lead auto-converts to Contact + Account + Opportunity). Lighter to indicate the user does not trigger this.
